| 점검 | 무엇을 보나 |

        if frac[top] >= 0.8 and all(frac[t] <= 0.2 for t in TPS if t != top):

                             mean_pct_top=gp.loc[tp == top, g].mean(),
                             mean_pct_others=gp.loc[tp != top, g].mean()))

# per-sample share of flagged genera concentrated at 0W (1% grid)
f1 = summary[0][1]
for t in TPS:
    gs = f1.loc[f1.tp == t, "genus"].tolist()

import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import wilcoxon
pd.set_option("display.width", 250)
d, sip, sc = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
si = pd.read_csv(sip, sep="\t").set_index("sample_id")
gp = pd.read_csv(d + "/genus_pct.tsv", sep="\t").set_index("sample_id").loc[si.index]
TARGETS = ["Cutibacterium", "Staphylococcus"]

def signrank_cdf(n):
    # exact null distribution of T+ for n untied nonzero differences
    N = n * (n + 1) // 2
    cnt = np.zeros(N + 1, dtype=object); cnt[0] = 1
    for k in range(1, n + 1):
        new = cnt.copy()
        new[k:] = cnt[k:] + cnt[:-k]
        cnt = new
    p = np.array([float(c) for c in cnt]) / 2.0 ** n
    return np.cumsum(p)

def hl_exact(diff, alpha=0.05):
    diff = np.asarray(diff, float)
    n = len(diff)
    w = np.sort([(diff[i] + diff[j]) / 2 for i in range(n) for j in range(i, n)])
    cdf = signrank_cdf(n)
    c = int(np.max(np.where(cdf <= alpha / 2)[0]))  # P(T+<=c)<=alpha/2
    N = len(w)
    return float(np.median(w)), float(w[c]), float(w[N - c - 1]), 1 - 2 * cdf[c]

def paired(tab, g, a, b):
    x = tab.loc[(si.timepoint == a)].set_index(si.loc[si.timepoint == a, "subject"])[g]
    y = tab.loc[(si.timepoint == b)].set_index(si.loc[si.timepoint == b, "subject"])[g]
    x, y = x.sort_index(), y.reindex(x.sort_index().index)
    dlt = (y - x).values
    nz = dlt[dlt != 0]
    p = wilcoxon(nz, alternative="two-sided", method="exact").pvalue
    hl, lo, hi, conf = hl_exact(nz)
    return dict(genus=g, cmp=f"{a}->{b}", n=len(nz), med_a=np.median(x), med_b=np.median(y),
                n_up=int((dlt > 0).sum()), n_down=int((dlt < 0).sum()),
                p_exact=p, HL=hl, CI_lo=lo, CI_hi=hi, ci_conf=round(conf, 4))

def report(tab, label):
    rows = []
    for g in TARGETS + ["Cuti+Staph"]:
        for a, b in [("0W", "4W"), ("0W", "2W"), ("2W", "4W")]:
            rows.append(paired(tab, g, a, b))
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    print("=" * 20, label)
    print(df.to_string(index=False, float_format=lambda v: f"{v:.4g}"))
    return df

base = gp.copy(); base["Cuti+Staph"] = base.Cutibacterium + base.Staphylococcus
r0 = report(base, "원자료 (상대 % , 분모 = 전체 리드)")

def renorm(drop):
    t = gp.drop(columns=drop)
    t = t.div(t.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100
    t["Cuti+Staph"] = t.Cutibacterium + t.Staphylococcus
    return t

for fn, lab in [("flag_1.txt", "1%"), ("flag_01.txt", "0.1%"), ("flag_0.txt", "0%")]:
    fl = pd.read_csv(sc + "/" + fn, sep="\t", header=None, names=["genus", "tp", "n"])
    drop_all = fl.genus.tolist()
    drop_0w = fl[fl.tp == "0W"].genus.tolist()
    assert not set(TARGETS) & set(drop_all)
    t = renorm(drop_all)
    print(f"\n[민감도] 문턱 {lab}: 표시된 속 {len(drop_all)}개 전부 분모에서 제외")
    report(t, f"sens {lab} all-flagged removed")
    t = renorm(drop_0w)
    print(f"\n[민감도] 문턱 {lab}: 0W 몰림 속 {len(drop_0w)}개만 제외")
    report(t, f"sens {lab} 0W-flagged removed")

# extra reference: also drop Unassigned
fl = pd.read_csv(sc + "/flag_1.txt", sep="\t", header=None, names=["genus", "tp", "n"])
report(renorm(fl.genus.tolist() + ["Unassigned"]), "ref: 1% flagged + Unassigned removed")

                    "Cuti_4W": gp.loc[s4.reindex(s0.index).sample_id, "Cutibacterium"].values,
                    "Staph_0W": gp.loc[s0.sample_id, "Staphylococcus"].values,
                    "Staph_4W": gp.loc[s4.reindex(s0.index).sample_id, "Staphylococcus"].values,
                    "Wolb_0W": gp.loc[s0.sample_id, "Wolbachia"].values}, index=s0.index).sort_index()

import sys
import pandas as pd
d, sip = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
si = pd.read_csv(sip, sep="\t").set_index("sample_id")
gp = pd.read_csv(d + "/genus_pct.tsv", sep="\t").set_index("sample_id").loc[si.index]
tp = si.timepoint
for g in ["Wolbachia", "Sphingomonas", "Akkermansia", "Acetobacter", "Lachnospiraceae NK4A136 group", "Bacteroides", "Cutibacterium", "Staphylococcus"]:
    parts = []
    for thr, lab in [(1, ">=1"), (0.1, ">=0.1"), (0, ">0")]:
        m = gp[g] > 0 if thr == 0 else gp[g] >= thr
        c = tp[m].value_counts().reindex(["0W", "2W", "4W"], fill_value=0)
        n = int(m.sum())
        parts.append(f"{lab}: n={n} " + "/".join(str(int(v)) for v in c.values) + (f" (0W {c['0W']/n:.0%})" if n else ""))
    print(f"{g:32s} | " + " | ".join(parts))
six = ["Wolbachia", "Sphingomonas", "Akkermansia", "Acetobacter", "Lachnospiraceae NK4A136 group", "Bacteroides"]
s = gp[six].sum(axis=1)
print("six-genus block % by timepoint:", s.groupby(tp).agg(["median", "min", "max"]).round(2).to_dict("index"))
print("Unassigned by tp:", gp["Unassigned"].groupby(tp).agg(["median", "min", "max"]).round(2).to_dict("index"))
# mean of non-block share at 0W
print("0W non-block share median:", (100 - s[tp == "0W"]).median().round(2))
